mara_arrival.title: Mara · beside the fountain
mara_arrival.text:
“I know exactly how many steps it is to the lake now. I used to know how the swallows nested under the crossing.”

Mara lowers a bucket. The rim has worn a pale line across her glove.

“The pump stopped, so we're carrying the water. We promised Ivo we'd help lift that beam. Hard to be in both places.”

She glances toward the workshop.

“There's a spare regulator on the rack. Someone put it aside before they knew who would need it. I like that.”

ivo_arrival.title: Ivo · the waiting beam
ivo_arrival.text:
Ivo runs a thumb along a knot in the lifting rope.

“My teacher used to leave the easy knots for me. Took years to notice.”

He looks toward the people carrying buckets.

“The beam needs several hands together. The pump's keeping those hands busy. There's a spare regulator in the workshop, but its spring lever has to stay open while you fit it.”

“The echo spool can repeat the lever's movement. The long-reach coupler can hold it through the opening beside the bypass. Try whichever makes sense to you.”

mara_deferred.title: Mara · another round
mara_deferred.text:
“Find anything up there?”

Mara listens with a bucket resting against her boot.

“We've made another round. Ivo put covers over the ropes; we'll lift the beam when we can spare the crew.”

She shifts her grip.

“The workshop is still open. If you're heading that way, the spare's on the rack.”

ivo_deferred.title: Ivo · a place kept ready
ivo_deferred.text:
The lifting ropes are tucked beneath a cover. Ivo checks the edge where rain might collect.

“Nothing wrong with keeping a place ready.”

He looks toward the buckets.

“We're still carrying the water. Once the pump is running and the crew has a moment, we'll come back to this.”

mara_crossing.title: Mara · at the crossing
mara_crossing.text:
“I walked toward the lake with an empty bucket. Got halfway before I remembered.”

Mara laughs and takes her place at the rope. Behind her, the fountain runs.

“A jug takes a moment to fill now. That's how we all found time to be here.”

She looks up beneath the unfinished crossing.

“I wonder if the swallows will come back.”

ivo_crossing.title: Ivo · a shared lift
ivo_crossing.text:
Ivo slides the rope through his hands until he finds the old knot.

“Same beam. Same weight.”

He looks along the line of people, each waiting for the others to be ready.

“The pump gave us the afternoon back. Mara says we should use some of it to sit down.”

pump_broken.title: The communal pump
pump_broken.text:
A green housing, a brass coupling brighter than its neighbors, a patch that never quite matched the paint. Someone tried to make this last.

A cracked regulator has stopped the courtyard supply. The maintenance note is plain: take the spare regulator from the rack; hold the service bypass open with a borrowed tool; fit the replacement at the bypass.

Two tools wait on the workbench. An inspection opening beside the bypass offers a second way to reach the spring-return lever.

At the bottom of the note: “Please leave the spare gasket in its cloth.”

pump_restored.title: Water finds its way
pump_restored.text:
The first sound is a shiver in the pipe. Then water, farther away, finding the fountain.

Your replacement sits beside an older repair. From the doorway it is difficult to tell which work belongs to whom.

The upper path is open. When you return to the courtyard from there, look for Mara and Ivo at the crossing.

bench.title: The workbench · choose a tool
bench.text:
The cloth has a clean outline where each tool usually rests.

Echo spool: record the spring lever, then start the repeating movement at the bypass. The echo keeps holding until you release it.

Long-reach coupler: at the bypass, reach through the inspection opening and hold the same lever.

Either leaves your hands free to fit the spare regulator from the rack. Come back and swap tools whenever you like; returning one releases its hold.

archive.title: Archive fragment · a correction kept
archive.text:
TEST 14 — “Pressure stable. Repair complete.”

Another hand has added:

“Stable with one tap open. It fell again when everyone filled their jugs. Next time, test the farthest tap while the courtyard draws water.”

A third note is folded around the first two:

“I nearly threw away the wrong report. Then I remembered why it looked convincing. Keep them together.”

There is a small water stain across the word “complete.”

On the back, a question without an answer: “Who wasn't here when we decided it worked?”

plaque.title: A small inscription
plaque.text:
THE OBSERVATORY

“Leave the correction where the next person can find it.”

Four shallow marks show where an older plate was fitted. The new inscription covers the words, but not the holes.

return_deferred.title: Return to the courtyard?
return_deferred.text:
Below, a bucket catches the light. The pump is still waiting for its repair, and the residents are keeping the water moving by hand.

Head back to see them? The workshop remains open. There is also a seat beside the lake.

return_repaired.title: Return to the courtyard?
return_repaired.text:
From here you can hear the fountain. By the time you reach the courtyard, the residents should have put down the buckets and gathered at the crossing.

Head back to see them? The archive will still be here.

arrive_deferred.title: The work that continues
arrive_deferred.text:
Mara adjusts a bucket lid. Ivo smooths the cover over the lifting ropes. Small preparations, keeping other work possible.

The supply still depends on carrying water from the lake. The workshop door is open.

arrive_repaired.title: Hands for the crossing
arrive_repaired.text:
For a moment, the bucket shelter is empty of people.

They are at the crossing, finding places along the rope. Behind them the fountain runs, doing the work that occupied their hands.

Mara notices you and lifts a hand before taking hold again.

ending_deferred.title: By the lake · a visit left open
ending_deferred.text:
A bucket touches stone. Water settles. Footsteps turn back toward the courtyard.

The pump and crossing remain unfinished, but the ropes are covered and the spare regulator is waiting. Someone has kept those possibilities open.

From this seat you can see the workshop door. Beyond it, the upper path disappears between the trees.

ending_repaired.title: By the lake · room for the next thing
ending_repaired.text:
The sound of the fountain reaches the lake in small, uneven pieces. At the crossing, the crew takes the strain together.

Mara's bucket is upside down beneath the shelter, drying. For a while, it can simply be an object.

Across the water, a window in the old observatory catches the light. You cannot tell whether the room behind it is empty.
